title: Electronics Tutorials
summary: Free, well-illustrated tutorials on basic electronics: passive components, AC and DC theory, transistors, op-amps, filters, oscillators and digital logic, each topic built up from first principles.

title: All About Circuits
summary: A large electronics site with a free online textbook on DC, AC, semiconductor and digital circuits, technical articles, worksheets and a set of design calculators.

title: Negative Feedback
summary: Why feeding an op-amp's output straight back to its inverting input makes it follow the input: the voltage follower and the idea of negative feedback, step by step.

title: Divided Feedback
summary: How a resistor divider in the feedback path sets the gain of an op-amp, for both the non-inverting and the inverting amplifier, with worked voltage and current examples.

title: The “Operational” Amplifier
summary: Where op-amps come from (analog computing) and how an op-amp without feedback acts as a comparator that switches its output to one rail or the other.

title: Differentiator and Integrator Circuits
summary: Op-amp circuits with a capacitor in the feedback or input path that integrate or differentiate a voltage over time, the building block behind ramps and filter stages.

title: Low-pass Filters
summary: Passive low-pass filters built from a resistor with a capacitor or an inductor, and how to calculate their cutoff frequency.
